sql: SELECT ROUND(((SELECT n.value FROM sub s JOIN dnum n ON n.adsh = s.adsh WHERE s.name = 'APPLE INC' AND s.form = '10-Q' AND s.period = 20260630 AND n.tag = 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' AND n.ddate = 20260630 AND n.qtrs = 3 AND n.uom = 'USD' AND n.ndims = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim d WHERE d.fact_id = n.fact_id AND d.axis = 'ProductOrService' AND d.member = 'Service')) - (SELECT n.value FROM sub s JOIN dnum n ON n.adsh = s.adsh WHERE s.name = 'APPLE INC' AND s.form = '10-Q' AND s.period = 20260630 AND n.tag = 'CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold' AND n.ddate = 20260630 AND n.qtrs = 3 AND n.uom = 'USD' AND n.ndims = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim d WHERE d.fact_id = n.fact_id AND d.axis = 'ProductOrService' AND d.member = 'Service'))) * 1.0 / (SELECT n.value FROM sub s JOIN dnum n ON n.adsh = s.adsh WHERE s.name = 'APPLE INC' AND s.form = '10-Q' AND s.period = 20260630 AND n.tag = 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' AND n.ddate = 20260630 AND n.qtrs = 3 AND n.uom = 'USD' AND n.ndims = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim d WHERE d.fact_id = n.fact_id AND d.axis = 'ProductOrService' AND d.member = 'Service')), 4)
